# Task-by-oracle matrix (pilot)

Status: draft. It will be frozen with the tasks in Month 1 and filed with
the OSF pre-registration.

This matrix decides, before any model is run, which independent checks
apply to each task. An oracle marked N/A is never run for that task, and
false assurance is computed over applicable oracles only (ADR-004).

The section below the marker is generated from the task specs in `tasks/`
by `otb matrix --write protocol/ORACLE_MATRIX.md`. A test fails if it is out
of date.

## MLDSA-T41-power2round

- **reference-intermediate** (applies): Exhaustive: every r in [0, q) (8,380,417 cases), compared with mldsa-native's power2round (arguments mapped to this signature) and with the spec-literal implementation.
- **acvp** (N/A): Component function. ACVP tests top-level functions only (GAP-ACVP-001).
- **malformed-input** (N/A): Malformed-input tests apply to ML-KEM encapsulation and decapsulation only.
- **implicit-rejection** (N/A): Implicit rejection is a property of ML-KEM decapsulation only.
- **ct-valgrind** (applies): r marked undefined before the call; r1 declassified after it. Built with the pinned compiler at -O2 and at -O3, no sanitizers.
- **ct-static-division** (applies): Primary: emitted machine code at -O2 and -O3 for the pinned targets. Secondary diagnostic: LLVM IR at -O0 (ADR-005).
- **ct-dudect** (N/A): Not in the draft dudect subsample (MLKEM-T07, MLKEM-T24). The subsample is fixed in the pre-registration.
- **differential** (N/A): Differential fuzzing belongs to Arm 3 (C-to-Rust migration), not Arm 1 tasks.

## MLDSA-T47-make-hint

- **reference-intermediate** (applies): Sampled and boundary inputs: 1,000,000 seeded random (z, r) pairs, plus every r within 2 of a HighBits boundary paired with z in {0, 1, q - 1, gamma2, q - gamma2}. Expected value: FIPS 204 Algorithm 39 computed as HighBits(r) != HighBits(r + z), with HighBits (Algorithm 37) taken from mldsa-native's decompose, and from the spec-literal implementation. mldsa-native's make_hint(a0, a1) is not compared directly.
- **acvp** (N/A): Component function. ACVP tests top-level functions only (GAP-ACVP-001).
- **malformed-input** (N/A): Malformed-input tests apply to ML-KEM encapsulation and decapsulation only.
- **implicit-rejection** (N/A): Implicit rejection is a property of ML-KEM decapsulation only.
- **ct-valgrind** (applies): z and r marked undefined before the call; the return value declassified after it. Built with the pinned compiler at -O2 and at -O3, no sanitizers. Timing variation in the signing loop is expected and excluded by the matrix (GAP-CT-004).
- **ct-static-division** (applies): Primary: emitted machine code at -O2 and -O3 for the pinned targets. Secondary diagnostic: LLVM IR at -O0 (ADR-005).
- **ct-dudect** (N/A): Not in the draft dudect subsample (MLKEM-T07, MLKEM-T24). The subsample is fixed in the pre-registration.
- **differential** (N/A): Differential fuzzing belongs to Arm 3 (C-to-Rust migration), not Arm 1 tasks.

## MLKEM-T01-ntt

- **reference-intermediate** (applies): All 256 unit vectors (the NTT is linear, so these fix it completely), the all-zero and all-(q-1) inputs, and 1,000 seeded random inputs. Outputs are reduced mod q and compared with mlkem-native (portable C backend) and with the spec-literal implementation.
- **acvp** (N/A): Component function. ACVP tests top-level functions only (GAP-ACVP-001).
- **malformed-input** (N/A): Component function with a fixed-size array input. Malformed-input tests apply to ML-KEM encapsulation and decapsulation only.
- **implicit-rejection** (N/A): Implicit rejection is a property of ML-KEM decapsulation only.
- **ct-valgrind** (applies): f marked undefined before the call. Built with the pinned compiler at -O2 and at -O3, no sanitizers.
- **ct-static-division** (applies): Primary: emitted machine code at -O2 and -O3 for the pinned targets. Secondary diagnostic: LLVM IR at -O0 (ADR-005).
- **ct-dudect** (N/A): Not in the draft dudect subsample (MLKEM-T07, MLKEM-T24). The subsample is fixed in the pre-registration.
- **differential** (N/A): Differential fuzzing belongs to Arm 3 (C-to-Rust migration), not Arm 1 tasks.

## MLKEM-T07-compress-d

- **reference-intermediate** (applies): Exhaustive: every x in [0, q) for each d in {1, 4, 5, 10, 11} (16,645 cases), compared with mlkem-native's scalar compress functions and with the spec-literal implementation.
- **acvp** (N/A): Component function. ACVP tests top-level functions only (GAP-ACVP-001).
- **malformed-input** (N/A): Component function. Malformed-input tests apply to ML-KEM encapsulation and decapsulation only.
- **implicit-rejection** (N/A): Implicit rejection is a property of ML-KEM decapsulation only.
- **ct-valgrind** (applies): x marked undefined before the call; d is public. Built with the pinned compiler at -O2 and at -O3, no sanitizers. Division itself is invisible to Valgrind (GAP-CT-001).
- **ct-static-division** (applies): Primary: emitted machine code at -O2 and -O3 for the pinned targets, flagging division instructions and division helper calls. Secondary diagnostic: LLVM IR at -O0, flagging udiv, sdiv, urem and srem (ADR-005).
- **ct-dudect** (applies): Draft subsample member. Two input classes (fixed x versus random x), fixed measurement budget, threshold |t| > 10. Nightly only, reported separately (GAP-CT-003).
- **differential** (N/A): Differential fuzzing belongs to Arm 3 (C-to-Rust migration), not Arm 1 tasks.

## MLKEM-T24-decaps-implicit-rejection

- **reference-intermediate** (N/A): Top-level function. Its outputs are checked by acvp, malformed-input and implicit-rejection.
- **acvp** (applies): ML-KEM-encapDecap-FIPS203 vectors at a pinned ACVP-Server commit: every ML-KEM-768 decapsulation test case, and every decapsulationKeyCheck test case. Counts reported by test group.
- **malformed-input** (applies): Wrong ct_len (FIPS 203 section 7.3 check 1, required on every call) and wrong dk_len (check 2) must return nonzero. Task contract, stricter than FIPS 203: the dk hash check (check 3, Eq. 7.2) must run on every call; a failure here is a task-contract violation, not a FIPS violation (GAP-SPEC-001).
- **implicit-rejection** (applies): A modified ct must give ss = J(z || c), computed independently, and the same return value as the valid path (FIPS 203 section 6.3: the implicit-reject flag must not be returned in any form).
- **ct-valgrind** (applies): dk marked undefined before the call. Built with the pinned compiler at -O2 and at -O3, no sanitizers. Covers the ciphertext comparison and the selection of the shared secret.
- **ct-static-division** (applies): Primary: emitted machine code at -O2 and -O3 for the pinned targets. Secondary diagnostic: LLVM IR at -O0 (ADR-005).
- **ct-dudect** (applies): Draft subsample member. Two input classes (valid ct versus modified ct), fixed measurement budget, threshold |t| > 10. Nightly only, reported separately (GAP-CT-003).
- **differential** (N/A): Differential fuzzing belongs to Arm 3 (C-to-Rust migration), not Arm 1 tasks.
